observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ihiwalay ang lokal at agarang senyales, humingi ng tulong sa hirap sa paghinga at ilahad ang saklaw ng gamot.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Sort local versus urgent signs, activate help for breathing difficulty and state medication boundaries.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag ituring na karaniwang tusok ang hirap sa paghinga, maantala sa home remedy, o magbigay ng gamot nang walang pahintulot at training.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not treat breathing difficulty as a routine local sting, delay referral for home remedies, or administer a drug outside training and authorization.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Ihiwalay ang lokal at agarang senyales, humingi ng tulong sa hirap sa paghinga at ilahad ang saklaw ng gamot. Nagawa nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the task without prompting: Sort local versus urgent signs, activate help for breathing difficulty and state medication boundaries.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang tugon ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa referral o hangganan ng tungkulin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Performs the response but needs a prompt about referral or scope.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag ituring na karaniwang tusok ang hirap sa paghinga, maantala sa home remedy, o magbigay ng gamot nang walang pahintulot at training.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not treat breathing difficulty as a routine local sting, delay referral for home remedies, or administer a drug outside training and authorization.
